description: This file defines the IDurableStateMachine interface for a durable persistent state machine with methods for applying logs, snapshots, recovery notifications, and deep copying, specific to the Orleans distributed framework.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine, clearing any volatile state, and can be called during recovery.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry or snapshot to the state machine during recovery.

methods.name: OnRecoveryCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that all prior log entries and snapshots have been applied.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Writes pending state changes to the log.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the state machine.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that prior log entries and snapshots have been written to stable storage.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the state machine instance.
